filesystem_residuals: Quarantine-and-verify is mitigation, not elimination. Public macOS descriptor-relative and rename APIs, including renameatx_np, do not provide terminal mutation conditional on an expected device, inode, vnode generation, or content token.

Source-parent authorization and capture are not atomic. One winning same-UID relocation can delete one eligible outside-root regular file or symlink whose bytes are unbounded, or quarantine one ineligible directory whose subtree is unbounded.
The final ACL/BSD-metadata-check-to-unlinkat race can delete one already captured expected regular file or symlink after its authorization metadata changes; regular-file bytes are unbounded.
Terminal quarantine lacks an authorized restore, release, or purge disposition and cannot be acknowledged while the protected leaf exists; 32 conflicts can exhaust every protected slot on one volume.

Caller-ledger removal, relocation, or lock-inode replacement and project-generation races can strand or allow up to 32 captured or terminal transactions per protected volume; each affected regular file can contain unbounded bytes.

Writable descriptors and hard links prevent an exact immutable-content guarantee. Startup fencing, terminal physical-state repair, daemon-owned discovery and revoke, project-binding revoke and garbage collection, qualified volume behavior, freshness, and direct daemon execution remain open.
The full signed distinct-process 57-row crash, adversarial, lifecycle, volume, hard-link, writable-descriptor, Release, and notarization matrix has not run.
